study.title: Real-time automatic prediction of treatment response to transcatheter arterial chemoembolization in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma using deep learning based on digital subtraction angiography videos

imaging.modality_detail: Pre-TACE DSA videos of the proper or branch hepatic artery (PNG/AVI from PACS), 1021 x 788 resolution
imaging.territory_detail: Hepatic artery angiography in hepatocellular carcinoma before TACE

data_released.detail: Data not publicly available due to patient privacy; available from corresponding author on reasonable request

annotation.annotator_expertise: Two experienced radiologists delineated tumor and liver with Labelme, checked by one experienced interventional radiologist; response assessed by two radiologists (>5 years) checked by an interventional radiologist (8 years)
annotation.inter_rater_value: ICC 0.930-0.944 for treatment response evaluation between two observers

task.task_description: DSA-Net: a U-Net-based model with temporal difference learning and liver region segmentation segments HCC tumors on DSA video key frames (Model 1); a ResNet18 + MLP model combines key frames, segmentation results and clinical variables to predict response (mRECIST CR/PR vs SD/PD) to the first TACE session (Model 2).
task.clinical_application: Pre-procedural prediction of TACE treatment response and real-time tumor localization in intermediate-stage hepatocellular carcinoma

temporal_evidence.quote: the learned temporal difference (256 × 256 × 1) by TDL and the predicted liver region masks (256 × 256 × 1) by LRS, were concatenated and fed into this network

multimodal_inputs: clinical variables (demographics, HBV, AFP, liver function and laboratory parameters)

evaluation.external_validation_detail: Independent external validation cohort of 121 patients (122 DSA videos) from a second hospital, diagnosed 2016-2020

comparators: ResNet on key frames + segmentation without clinical data

G2.quote: Thus, large-scale external validations in HBV endemic and non-endemic areas are necessary.

G3.quote: Considering the specificity of DSA videos, we proposed the novel Model 1 for HCC segmentation, which included a temporal difference learning (TDL) module

G6.quote: First, this was a retrospective study; thus, some bias between the medical record system and real practice is inevitable. Thus, further prospective multicenter studies are needed

G8.quote: Model 2 integrated the DSA videos, segmentation results, and clinical variables to predict treatment response to the first TACE session

G11.quote: Kaplan-Meier curves showed a significant difference in progression-free survival between the responders and nonresponders divided by Model 2

other_limitations: Small and multiple lesions frequently missed by segmentation
Motion artifacts and surrounding bowel/stomach interference cause false segmentation
Different fields of view across operators increase segmentation difficulty
Patients treated with drug-eluting beads excluded
future_work: Prospective multicenter studies to optimize DSA-Net
Large-scale external validation in HBV endemic and non-endemic areas
Multitherapy trial to determine real-world clinical benefit
Integrate pathological results and tumor microenvironment information
Standardize technical operation procedures for real-world application
